Fugazi song preferences, ranked by estimated intercept (implied preference)

Source: R/data.R
fugazi_song_preferences.Rd

Produced by Repeatr_5 from the per-song intercept terms of results_ml_Repeatr4 (the omitted reference song - whichever has the smallest alt in altlookup - is added back in with an estimate of 0), ranked from most to least preferred.

Usage

fugazi_song_preferences

Format

dataframe with one row for each song, ranked by estimated preference.

rank_rating

Rank of the song by estimated preference, 1 = most preferred

songid

numeric id for each song

title

The name of the song

Estimate

The estimated intercept for this song (0 for the omitted reference song)

z-value

The z-value of the estimate (NA for the omitted reference song)

Provenance

Derived-modeled. Produced by Repeatr_5 from results_ml_Repeatr4.

Examples

fugazi_song_preferences
#>    rank_rating songid                        title    Estimate    z-value
